Our Story

Small fire,
steady hands.

Oak Touch opens every evening in Badore, Ajah — a small stall built around one simple promise: everything is cooked fresh, in full view, the same night it is sold. No shortcuts, no leftovers carried into the next day.

What started as a single pot of akara has grown, batch by batch, into a small evening kitchen with a full product line and a loyal walk-up crowd. Every production is logged, every correction is learned from, and every night ends with a clean account of what worked and what didn't.

The business runs under a majority-stake partnership structure, currently in a formal trial period, aiming to prove out consistency and demand before scaling into a permanent storefront.

Crispy outside, soft inside — pure satisfaction in every bite.
Fresh
Bought and prepared the same day it's sold.
Clean
Hygienic prep, every batch, every night.
Made with Love
Small-batch, not mass production.
What We Serve

The line-up.

Five signature offerings, sold hot off the fire every night: Akara, Fried Yam, Fried Potato, our Pomo & Beef sauce, and a build-your-own Combo. Puff-Puff is currently in development, joining the menu once demand and capacity are ready.

Every plate is prepared to order — nothing sits and waits.
How We Work

The nightly rhythm.

2:30 – 3:00 PM
Washing and prep begins — ingredients measured for the night's batch only.
4:00 – 5:00 PM
Production starts. Umbrella, lighting, gas and water set up on site.
6:00 PM
Doors open for the evening.
11:30 PM – 12:00 AM
Firm closing time, sold out or not. Anything left in good condition is given out rather than risked to spoilage.
Buy-as-needed
Ingredients purchased fresh for the next day only — no standing stock, no waste in storage.
Same-night accounting
Each production is numbered and logged before the next batch begins.
Zero-waste discipline
Unsold product in good condition goes to charity rather than being thrown away.
Growth & Structure

Built on a trial.
Growing by the record.

Oak Touch is operating under a two-month trial partnership, with a majority 60% stake held by the founder. Launch capital covered equipment, opening materials and logistics, with investor protections built into the partnership agreement.
